verdict.rationale: A live probe shows Formant publishes an llms.txt at docs.formant.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a documentation summary header). Its ReadMe-hosted docs also expose markdown mirrors of every page, and endpoint mirrors embed full OpenAPI JSON, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the docs, a complete downloadable spec or llms-full-style consolidated corpus, explicit agent-oriented usage guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: every endpoint page's markdown mirror embeds that operation's full OpenAPI JSON
